name: the crown wars
lore:
The Crown Wars were not merely a conflict of kings, but a slow poisoning of the world’s marrow. In that age, elven grace curdled into imperial avarice, transforming the "People" from stewards of the wild into architects of ruin. 

Ecologically, the devastation remains a festering wound. The "Dark Disaster" scoured the lush realm of Miyeritar, transmuting vibrant rainforests into the desolate, mist-choked High Moor. Even now, the soil there rejects natural growth; instead, it yields twisted, magic-scarred flora and aggressive, mutated fauna—descendants of war-beasts left to prowl the ruins.

Behaviorally, this era birthed a cold, calculated cruelty. Kin turned upon kin with arcane atrocities that scarred the very weave of magic. It was a time of absolute radicalization, culminating in the Descent of the Drow—a spiritual and physical fracturing that haunts our forests and caverns to this day.
